text: # HR Team PTO Policy ## Previous Policy (through Dec 31, 2025) Full-time HR staff accrued 15 days of paid time off per year, credited monthly at 1.25 days per month. Unused PTO could roll over up to 5 days into the next calendar year. Any request covering more than three consecutive days required two weeks' advance notice to a manager. ## Updated Policy (effective Jan 1, 2026) Starting January 1, 2026, full-time HR staff accrue 20 days of paid time off per year, credited monthly at approximately 1.67 days per month. The rollover cap was raised from 5 days to 10 days. The two-week notice requirement for multi-day requests is unchanged. HR leadership approved this change after benchmarking the department's benefits against industry peers. ## Summary of the Change The HR team's annual PTO allowance increased from 15 days to 20 days — a gain of 5 days per year, roughly a 33% increase.
